JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

WITH 
-- Calculate the number of customers per segment for each year
segment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('year', Date) AS Year,
        Segment,
        COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date >= '201301' AND Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate total consumption per customer per year
total_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Year,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date >= '201301' AND Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Year
),
-- Calculate annual average consumption per customer per segment
avg_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Year,
        Segment,
        ROUND(TotalConsumption.TotalConsumption / COUNT(*), 2) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM total_consumption
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the lowest consumption per segment per year
lowest_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Year,
        Segment,
        MIN(Consumption) AS LowestConsumption
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date >= '201301' AND Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the difference in annual average between SME and LAM for each segment
diff_sme_lam AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS SME_Avg,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS LAM_Avg
    FROM avg_consumption
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM')
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the difference in annual average between LAM and KAM for each segment
diff_lam_kam AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS LAM_Avg,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS KAM_Avg
    FROM avg_consumption
    WHERE Segment IN ('LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the difference in annual average between KAM and SME for each segment

    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS KAM_Avg,

    FROM avg_consumption
    WHERE Segment IN ('KAM', 'SME')

)

    'Between 201301 And 201312' AS DateRange,

        WHEN (SELECT LAM_Avg FROM diff_lam_kam WHERE Year = 201301 AND Segment = 'LAM') > (SELECT LAM_Avg FROM diff_lam_kam WHERE Year = 201301 AND Segment = 'KAM')

JOIN "member" m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN "major" z ON m.link_to_major = z.major_id
JOIN "zip_code" c ON m.zip = c.zip_code
WHERE b.category = 'Food'

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as TotalPatients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as InpatientCount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as OutpatientCount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as MaleInpatient,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as MaleOutpatient,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / 
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100,
        2
    ) as MaleDeviationPercentage
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE SEX = 'M'
GROUP BY Admission, SEX
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

WITH PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_fifa_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        p.height,
        SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) AS total_heading_accuracy,
        COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS player_count
    FROM Player p
    LEFT JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id
    GROUP BY p.player_fifa_api_id, p.player_name, p.height
),
RankedPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        player_fifa_api_id,
        player_name,
        height,
        total_heading_accuracy,
        player_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_fifa_api_id 
            ORDER BY total_heading_accuracy DESC, player_count DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM PlayerStats
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    height,
    total_heading_accuracy,
    player_count
FROM RankedPlayers
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name

sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    p.player_fifa_api_id,
    p.player_api_id,
    p.id,
    MAX(pa.overall_rating) as max_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.overall_rating)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
)
GROUP BY p.id, p.player_name, p.player_fifa_api_id, p.player_api_id
ORDER BY max_rating DESC
LIMIT 1

sql:

    MIN(year) AS first_race_year,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton') AS points
FROM seasons s
JOIN races r ON s.url = r.url
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = (SELECT MIN(year) FROM seasons)
AND d.forename = 'Lewis'
AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'

  AND r2.round = 2

  AND d.nationality = 'Chinese'
  AND d.number = 2
  AND r.statusId = 1

  AND r.round = 0

sql:
SELECT r.name, r.url
FROM races r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON d.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
WHERE d.nationality = 'Germany'
  AND s.year = (SELECT MIN(s2.year) FROM seasons s2 WHERE s2.driverId = d.driverId)
ORDER BY s.year ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    cr.name AS constructorName,
    cr.nationality AS constructorNationality,
    SUM(cr.points) AS totalScore
FROM constructors cr
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cr.constructorId = cs.constructorId
JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY cr.constructorId, cr.name, cr.nationality
ORDER BY totalScore DESC
LIMIT 1

```sql
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cr.constructorId = cs.constructorId
JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY cr.constructorId, cr.name, cr.nationality
ORDER BY totalScore DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

sql:
SELECT 
    c.name,
    c.convertedManaCost
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    set_translations st ON c.uuid = st.uuid
JOIN 
    set s ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE 
    s.name = 'Coldsnap'
    AND st.language = 'Italian'
    AND c.convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) FROM cards)
ORDER BY 
    c.convertedManaCost DESC

sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)::INTEGER)
    ) as percent,
    COUNT(*) as num_atoms
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND atom.bond_type = '-'
GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
ORDER BY percent DESC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.school, s.doc
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores s2 ON s.CDSCode = s2.cds
WHERE f.FundingType = 'LOCALLY FUNDING'
  AND (s2.Enrollment (Ages 5-17) - s2.Enrollment (K-12)) > (
    SELECT AVG(Enrollment (K-12) - Enrollment (Ages 5-17))
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN satscores s22 ON f2.CDSCode = s22.cds
    WHERE f2.FundingType = 'LOCALLY FUNDING'
  )
ORDER BY s.school, s.doc
